title: Upper Bounds for Local Learning Coefficients of Three-Layer Neural Networks
summary: Three-layer neural networks are known to form singular learning models, and their Bayesian asymptotic behavior is governed by the learning coefficient, or real log canonical threshold. Although this quantity has been clarified for regular models and for some special singular models, broadly applicable methods for evaluating it in neural networks remain limited. Recently, a formula for the local learning coefficient of semiregular models was proposed, yielding an upper bound on the learning coefficient.
